new_records.title: Ray test against the map hit collision
new_records.summary: A line query against the Havok hit collision of the map; the enemy sight check uses it as its last step and a hit before the target means the line is blocked.

new_records.title: MSB enemy placement groups
new_records.summary: Enemy parts in the MSB carry group ids; enemies placed with the same group count as friends for alert call sounds and platoon membership.

new_records.title: MSB route lists
new_records.summary: Ordered point lists stored in the MSB with a patrol type; enemies that are not in battle walk them.

new_records.title: MSB regions
new_records.summary: Named regions and points stored in the MSB that EMEVD events test for the player entering; they start AI hold release, boss arenas, warps and fog walls.

new_records.title: Navigation meshes
new_records.summary: Per block navigation meshes that enemy path moves query; the row flags decide which edges, jumps, drops and ladders a path may use.

new_records.title: Posture gauge value
new_records.summary: Posture is one per character gauge (stamina in the engine): a current value clamped to a maximum that hits reduce, regeneration refills each frame and a break reads, shared by every posture rule and by the HUD.

new_records.title: Sen as carried money
new_records.summary: Sen is the carried money integer: kills, purses and balloons add to it, shops and Sen Throw spend it, and a final death halves it.

new_records.title: Enemy blind state
new_records.summary: How an enemy behaves while blinded by Fistful of Ash or the firecracker burst: it loses sight of Wolf for a short time and acts on its blind reaction.

new_records.title: Item lots (drops and pickups)
new_records.summary: ItemLotParam rows are the lots that kills, treasure and events hand out, including Spirit Emblem and Regenerative Power drops.

new_records.title: Enemy NpcParam row
new_records.summary: One NpcParam row per enemy type and variant holds its model id (cXXXX), HP, posture, resistances, deathblow marks, rewards and AI ids; many other records read these fields.

new_records.title: Event flags
new_records.summary: Saved on/off and counter bits that EMEVD, ESD and params read and set; they carry story state, boss defeats, idol unlocks and talk gates.

new_records.title: Shinobi ninjutsu arts
new_records.summary: Equipped ninjutsu arts such as Bloodsmoke and Puppeteer: the equipped art gates special stealth deathblow rows and applies its effect after the stab.

new_records.title: Hit effects by material
new_records.summary: HitEffectSfx and HitEffectSe tables pick the spark, blood decal and sound of a hit from the attacker and target materials and the hit angle.

new_records.title: Story clock (time stage)
new_records.summary: The world time stage (morning, day, evening, night, bell evening) set by event flags; it picks lighting variants, sky domes and enemy scaling rows.

loops_kept.reason: true mutual dependency: the pool is only drained by the hit values and the values only mean something against the pool; they are one mechanism split in two records, kept in both directions
